description: The Center for Medical Cannabis and Psilocybin hosted the sixth Patient Qualification and Safety Committee meeting for the Medical Psilocybin Advisory Board. The Chair, Ian Dunn, facilitated the review of and approval for recommendation on the following: Patient Information Safety, Petition Submission Process, and Evidence Review Standards.
